correctness.rationale: An explicit greedy-position formula proves the even witness omits only all ones. A simultaneous induction proves exact SAS of odd witness V_q and S_q universality. The substitution maps zeros to 01 and ones to 00, giving exactly q_k ones, disjoint 01 pairs, and parity-specific suffixes (0100 or 01000101); these establish the complete lower and upper bounds on missing words for all ranks, with a direct rank-one check. Standalone independent DP/count and exhaustive finite tests passed ranks 1–11 and 1–5, respectively. No infinite claim is based on the finite check.

value.rationale: The invariant is motivated by the natural subsequence complexity of classical automatic words. The theorem classifies every shortest absent scattered word, not just counts, at every dyadic rank; the sharp parity switch one-versus-three and limiting index density one-third are structural and not obtained from a generic numerical sample. Two canonical witnesses give a reusable explanation for sparse-one morphic languages.
